Benfica season|2018–19]] | nextseason = [[2020–21 S.L. Benfica season|2020–21]] }} The 2019–20 [[S.L. Benfica|Sport Lisboa e Benfica]] season was the club's [[List of S.L. Benfica seasons|116th season]] in existence and its [[Primeira Liga#All-time Primeira Liga table|86th consecutive season]] in the top flight of [[Football in Portugal|Portuguese football]]. It started with a 5–0 win over [[Sporting CP]] in the [[2019 Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira|Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira]], on 4 August 2019, and concluded with a 2–1 loss to [[FC Porto]] in the [[2020 Taça de Portugal Final|Taça de Portugal final]], on 1 August 2020.
